name: material_appearance
scenario: Material appearance entries in the matter library should be trained against captured reality instead of guessed. The optimiser tunes albedo, roughness, and mottle parameters so that emitted splat populations match reference scan statistics.

constraints.why: mean luminance should be in physically plausible range — not pure black (0) nor pure white (1)
luminance variance should be non-zero (real surfaces have texture) but not excessive
roughness should be physically plausible — not mirror-polished (0) nor completely diffuse (1)

pinned.why: RGB channels must stay in valid range
RGB channels must stay in valid range
RGB channels must stay in valid range

maximize.why: real surfaces have asymmetric albedo distributions (skewed toward darker values from shadows and micro-geometry) — maximize skewness to capture this
